author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Solution
description: F# full-stack ToolUp.Platform application: primary {AppName}-Server + {AppName}-Client pair, one starter module, Build.fs, Docker Compose, CI workflow.

port-server.description: Server port. Must not clash with any port already bound on the dev machine — `tools/ToolUp.PortGuard` (run via scripts/New-ToolUpApp.ps1) can scan an adjacent app tree and reject clashing values.

port-client-vite.description: Vite dev-server port. Same clash-rejection contract as --port-server.

toolUpSdkVersion.description: ToolUp.Sdk meta-manifest version (drives every transitive ToolUp.* package version).

skipRestore.description: If true, skip dotnet restore after scaffolding.
